description:
Masdar's WISER Pioneers Program identifies and supports emerging leaders in renewable energy and sustainability through cohort-based engagements in Abu Dhabi. Each cohort call, including eligibility, benefits and the closing date, is announced on Masdar's strategic-initiatives page.

Programme Highlights

  • Masdar-backed platform connecting young professionals to the UAE clean-energy ecosystem
  • Cohort structure with mentorship and project engagement
  • Call-specific deadlines announced per cohort
  • Gateway to Abu Dhabi's renewable-energy and climate-tech networks

Who Should Apply

Early- and mid-career professionals and researchers in renewable energy, sustainability and climate fields, per each cohort's eligibility note.

Funding and Costs

Programme support per the current call, as described on the official WISER Pioneers page.

Deadline and How to Apply

Check the WISER Pioneers page for the live cohort call and follow the application instructions stated there. Key deadline information: Cohort-based call — the current round and its closing date are announced on the Masdar programme page.
